title: Security Deposit Caps
text: The security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall be as specified in the tenancy agreement, which shall not exceed: (a) two months' rent in case of residential premises; and (b) six months' rent in case of non-residential premises.

title: Landlord Maintenance Obligations
text: The landlord shall be responsible for structural repairs, whitewashing of walls and painting of doors and windows, and other major repairs as specified in the tenancy agreement.

title: Tenant Maintenance Obligations
text: The tenant shall be responsible for routine maintenance and repairs, such as drain cleaning, socket and switch repairs, kitchen fixture repairs, and replacement of glass panels.

title: Rent Revision Notice
text: Revision of rent between the landlord and the tenant shall be in accordance with the terms of the tenancy agreement. The landlord shall give a notice in writing to the tenant three months before the revised rent becomes due.

title: Overstaying Penalty
text: If a tenant fails to vacate the premises after the tenancy has expired or been terminated, the tenant shall be liable to pay double the monthly rent for the first two months and four times the monthly rent thereafter.

title: Essential Services Protection
text: No landlord or property manager shall, either by himself or through any person, withhold any essential supply or service in the premises occupied by the tenant.
